implementation.name: original-v1-training-attention-storage
implementation.scope: Same two forward paths and memory boundary as the original. A declared one-query/four-key, two-block toy row (scores 0, 0, ln 2, ln 2; values 2, 4, 6, 8) keeps running row statistics and partial output; the original matrix boxes stand for the full intermediates of this row trace, not a quadratic-capacity measurement; all backward/optimizer memory is omitted. Tiled execution is a separate alternative to the materialized path.
implementation.question: Which intermediates cross into HBM?

storyboard.label: Inputs retained in HBM
storyboard.description: Both alternatives begin with queries, keys, and values. No attention output exists yet.

storyboard.label: Materialized: compute and write scores
storyboard.description: The first kernel writes the full score matrix into HBM for the softmax consumer.

storyboard.label: Materialized: write probabilities
storyboard.description: Softmax reads scores and writes the full probability matrix in HBM. Scores are no longer required by this forward trace.

storyboard.label: Materialized: write output
storyboard.description: The value-weighting kernel reads probabilities and values, then writes output. No claim about saved backward tensors is made.

storyboard.label: Start tiled alternative
storyboard.description: Reset the alternative. Inputs remain in HBM; there is no full score or probability matrix there.

storyboard.label: Load first K/V block
storyboard.description: SRAM receives one working block and the query tile. Running state begins for the output rows.

storyboard.label: Consume first score/probability tile
storyboard.description: The first tile contributes to the running maximum, normalizer, and partial output. Its temporary scores/probabilities can be replaced afterward.

storyboard.label: Replace with second block
storyboard.description: The second block occupies the same temporary workspace. Running state from block 1 survives this replacement.

storyboard.label: Merge second block contribution
storyboard.description: Online softmax rescales prior accumulated state if the row maximum changes, then incorporates the new block. Normalization is still pending.

storyboard.label: Normalize and write output tile
storyboard.description: After the final block, normalization completes the output tile and writes it to HBM. Inputs/output remain; full quadratic intermediates were never written.

guard: Forward lifetime only; neither path represents total training memory. Online-softmax statistics survive tile replacement and output normalizes only after final tile.
